name: Substrate Artificial Inteligence, S.A.
summary: Headquartered in Madrid, Spain, Substrate Artificial Intelligence, S.A. was established in 2010 and is dedicated to conceiving and building advanced artificial intelligence systems. Its innovative solutions are deployed across a diverse array of sectors, including energy, livestock, healthcare, finance, fintech, and human resources. The company officially transitioned from its former designation, Substrate AI S.A., adopting its current name on July 28, 2021.
